verdict.rationale: monday.com is a work-management platform whose agents act on boards, items, and updates. Authoring and signing git commits is a source-control or coding-agent capability outside its product category. The only git-adjacent evidence is linking GitHub/GitLab pull requests to items, which does not make monday.com a commit author, so the commit-signing axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
